name: households
description: Households on the studied LV feeder
source: Gupta and Akhtar (2027) poster; UKPN open data

name: p_max_kw
description: Firm limit of the constrained feeder (500 kVA / 4 feeders x 0.95 pf x 0.85 winter derate)

name: background_peak_kw
description: Non-EV feeder peak in the constrained (winter) case

name: background_day_cv
description: Coefficient of variation of the lognormal day factor on background load

name: background_slot_cv
description: Coefficient of variation of half-hourly background noise (0.10/sqrt(75))

name: charger_kw
description: Home charger rating (32 A single phase)

name: charger_min_kw
description: Lowest modulated charging power (6 A x 230 V)

name: efficiency
description: Charging efficiency

name: consumption_kwh_per_100km
description: Specific consumption of a battery EV

name: battery_kwh
description: Usable battery capacity (cap on energy per session)

name: sessions_per_vehicle_day
description: Mean home-charging sessions per vehicle per day (k)
source: Gupta and Akhtar (2027) poster; DfT/GLA fleet data

name: mileage_mean_km_day
description: Mean daily distance (8900 miles/year battery-EV mean)

name: mileage_sigma
description: Lognormal shape of daily distance fitted to NTS mileage bands (R2 = 0.86)

name: soc_median
description: Median arrival state of charge (log-space blend of a published lognormal and the DfT survey median of 24%)

name: soc_sigma
description: Lognormal shape of arrival state of charge (gives a mean of 32.6%)

name: departure_mean_h
description: Mean next-morning departure time for evening and overnight arrivals

name: departure_sd_h
description: Standard deviation of next-morning departure time

name: daytime_dwell_min_h

name: daytime_dwell_max_h
description: Longest dwell for daytime (04:00-14:00) plug-ins

name: go_offpeak_p
description: Static ToU off-peak rate 00:30-05:30 (Octopus Go structure)

name: go_peak_p
description: Static ToU rate outside the off-peak window

name: flat_p
description: Flat rate (default tariff cap) for uncontrolled charging

name: agile_multiplier
description: Agile retail price = multiplier x wholesale + adder

name: agile_offset_p
description: Agile constant adder

name: agile_peak_adder_p
description: Agile adder 16:00-19:00

name: agile_cap_p
description: Agile price cap

name: wholesale_mean_p
description: Mean daily wholesale level of the synthetic price process

name: wholesale_day_cv
description: Coefficient of variation of the daily wholesale level

name: wholesale_slot_cv
description: Half-hourly noise on the synthetic wholesale shape

name: negative_night_share
description: Share of days with negative overnight wholesale prices

name: na_peak_price_p
description: Network-aware base price at the background peak (sets C1)

description: Quantile of the scenario ensemble used to assess utilisation

description: Damping of the fixed-point iteration

description: Scenario days per fixed-point round

description: Fixed-point rounds
